programme.title: 加密貨幣大解密 #6
programme.desc: 讓我們介紹鄧嘉瑪,一位開發數碼資料主權的創造家,並瞭解非同質化代幣如何讓我們擁有自己的人工智慧這是能震撼你的一集

programme.title: 電腦遊戲:電玩的故事
programme.desc: 《電腦遊戲:電玩的故事》是一部關於電子遊戲歷史的專題紀錄片歷時近 5 年製作,跨越了從技術起源到街機遊戲誕生的時光從《乓》到《食鬼》,《超級瑪利歐》到《盜墓者羅拉》,《毀滅戰士》,《俠盜獵車手》等等,我們編纂有史以來發展最快的新媒體的非凡故事

programme.title: 洪堡涼流 #1
programme.desc: 在智利託雷斯德爾潘恩,雪山融水注入指狀峽灣,延伸至海洋並匯入洋流,降低海水鹽度河口,濕地孕育眾多涉禽,而無數海灣與港口則吸引稀有的海豚與虎鯨

programme.title: 洪堡涼流 #2
programme.desc: 洪堡洋流雖比多數洋流緩慢,卻是世界上最具活力的洋流之一,因其行經距離極長深海海溝的湧升流將養分帶至海面,使浮遊植物大量繁盛,奠定複雜海洋食物鏈的基礎

programme.title: 洪堡涼流 #3
programme.desc: 這股洋流伴隨著智利獨特的藍鯨族群,也是其他極度稀有海洋哺乳動物的最後避風港從冰冷深海到高崖強風,洋流塑造出奇特棲地,也是一部關於生存的自然研究

programme.title: 美食足跡:南非 2 #5
programme.desc: 花園大道果真是南非的滄海遺珠,它是一條延伸200公裡的沿海公路,以其迷人的多樣性和無出其右的荒野而聞名

programme.title: 美食足跡:南非 2 #6
programme.desc: 華倫抵達開普敦,這不會是這座城市的平凡美食探索之旅;華倫在整集節目中致力深入研究南非一種特殊的烹飪風格- 開普馬來

programme.title: 美食足跡:南非 2 #7
programme.desc: 華倫在法蘭史霍克山谷探索博殊真度紅酒莊的無盡產物

programme.title: 美食足跡:南非 2 #8
programme.desc: 華倫繼續從心出發,前往更鮮為人知的赫爾馬努斯小鎮,在當地參觀紐頓莊臣-風景優美的紅酒農場,從而加深對紅酒的熱愛

programme.title: 美食足跡:南非 2 #9
programme.desc: 華倫正離開開普敦前往西開普省更寧靜的沿海地區和風景如畫的帕特諾斯特小鎮他在當地會驚嘆海邊村莊的氛圍,並沿著海灘騎電動單車

programme.title: 美食足跡:南非 2 #10
programme.desc: 作為華倫南非美食之旅的最後一章,他回歸叢林,這是所有前往彩虹國度旅行的精髓

programme.title: 丹佐華盛頓:美國代表人物
programme.desc: 這部深度紀錄片探討丹佐・華盛頓的非凡歷程,這位影壇巨星重新定義了好萊塢領銜男演員的形象與影響力

programme.title: 賀錦麗:明日傳奇
programme.desc: 本紀錄片探討賀錦麗從早年加州的生活到成為首位美國女性副總統的崛起經過,她對美國政壇的影響以及她有望成為首位女總統的潛力

programme.title: 電影大師 #1
programme.desc: 沒有多少電影製作人能像史蒂芬史匹柏一樣在業內50多年間如此生生不息和擁有影響力,他從亞利桑那州郊區到好萊塢聚光燈下的旅程是有史以來最偉大的故事之一

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #1
programme.desc: 認識新任野外戰士義工,他們將加入韋札的動物大家庭變髒是工作的一部分當然,隨時會有衝擊性的驚喜

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #2
programme.desc: 我們在本集目睹一場拯救一隻受驚黑高角羚的絕望任務這些反偷獵的大象智慧震驚所有人而且,總能忙裡偷閒

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #3
programme.desc: 義工們在本集近距離接觸標誌性的動物深入瞭解韋札的反偷獵成就還有,努力無堅不摧

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #4
programme.desc: 義工們探索社區在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人興奮的蜂蜜收成,新團員的加入,以及其中一人餵哺黑犀牛的夢想成真

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #5
programme.desc: 在引人入勝的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的夢想茱迪心愛的麂羚是時候回歸大自然例行的東非條紋羚捕捉行動發生意想不到的轉折

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #6

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: The Call duck is a domestic duck species native to the Netherlands Males can weigh about 570 to 680 grams Because its call is different from other ducks, Call Ducks were bred as hunting ducks, now most of them are used as pets They mainly live in the Netherlands, Japan, and Southeast Asia They were introduced to the pet market in recent years and were originally used by European hunters to lure wild ducks using their call Their ducklings are described as having fair skin, big breasts and round butts They can heal people's moods, and their cute appearance adds joy

programme.desc: Families call on some big-hearted but practical ‘Aunties’ to help them through the rocky terrain of modern life, from money woes to health problems and love life troublesReal people, real problems – there are times when families need nothing short of their own fairy godmother to help them through the rocky terrain of modern lifenFrom money woes to health problems, strife with the teenagers and love life troubles, AUNTY MOVES IN is a series that answers that call for help, in the form of the big-hearted Amiria Reriti and Ata Te Kanawa, real life aunties, who are also fully-qualified – with honours – from the University of Life

programme.desc: A compelling testimony to the possibilities of local activism, this environmental thriller follows investigative journalist, Matt Blomberg, and ocean activist, Paul Ferber, in their dangerous efforts to create a marine conservation area and combat the relentless tide of illegal fishing in Southeast Asia Along the way a new generation of Cambodian environmentalists are inspired to create a better life for their people

programme.title: Operation Wolf Patrol
programme.desc: Eco-activist Rod Coronado has made it his life's mission to advocate for the planet and the rights of animals In 2014 he formed Wolf Patrol, an activist group which fights to end hunting of the grey wolves that roam Wisconsin’s forests After 30 years of radical environmental action, which earned him the label 'eco-terrorist' and spells in prison, this intimate documentary follows Rod's journey to redefine his activism

programme.title: Immersion

programme.title: Following Seas
programme.desc: Bob and Nancy Griffith made twenty ocean voyages over two decades, fulfilling a dream of freedom and adventure in their 53-foot sailboat Nothing seemed impossible for this couple and their growing family as they travelled to some of the most remote places on earth, chronicling life at sea with their 16mm Bolex camera As narrated by Nancy in this extraordinary film, their unconventional life’s voyage brought unexpected challenges and sacrifices

programme.title: Tanzania Transit
programme.desc: On board a sleeper train crossing Tanzania, the stories of three passengers unfold Rukia is an entrepreneurial woman, on her way to begin a new life Isaya is an old Masai man heading back to the bush with his grandson Peter, a powerful preacher, makes money by letting his followers pay for his services This microcosm offers a glimpse into their lives as each character moves towards an uncertain future in this precarious society

programme.desc: Families call on some big-hearted but practical ‘Aunties’ to help them through the rocky terrain of modern life, from money woes to health problems and love life troublesReal people, real problems – there are times when families need nothing short of their own fairy godmother to help them through the rocky terrain of modern lifenFrom money woes to health problems, strife with the teenagers and love life troubles, AUNTY MOVES IN is a series that answers that call for help, in the form of the big-hearted Amiria Reriti and Ata Te Kanawa, real life aunties, who are also fully-qualified – with honours – from the University of Life

programme.title: Serial Swindlers
programme.desc: Exposing the world’s most convincing, creative, and criminally-adept con-men, Serial Swindlers goes inside their minds While their crimes and exploits are a ready-made Hollywood script, their exploits have left a trail of heartache, poverty and destruction

programme.title: Saving the Amazon
programme.desc: The Amazon plays a vital part in regulating the planet’s temperature And yet, in the last year, forest destruction in the Brazilian Amazon soared by 85 per cent The combination of illegal logging and slash and burn agriculture is decimating the land With huge profits to be made, the Amazon is a dangerous place to ask questions Despite the threat, the Amazonian tribes want the world to hear their message

programme.title: Deep in the Heart
programme.desc: Deep In The Heart follows four patients, Lisa, Ted, Greg and Pat, as they deal with the emotional drama of major life-saving surgery It’s an emotional story familiar to families up and down the country: skilled surgeons can fix bodies, but it’s up to the patients to make sure it doesn’t all go wrong again All four face pressure from their families to come out of denial and face reality Can they turn their lives around and quit the habits of a lifetime?

programme.title: Man on the Bus
programme.desc: Psychologist and filmmaker Eve always thought there was something not quite right about her family After a decade of searching for the truth about her mother's roots as a Polish holocaust survivor, Eve makes a remarkable discovery about a chance encounter that changed her life forever A compelling tale of two defining human traits — endurance and frailty — and a metaphor for the 20th century’s most painful trauma

programme.title: Sky's The Limit
programme.desc: A documentary exploring the muralist movement: the art of painting over breathtaking heights Windowless gable walls were graffiti painters’ early targets, particularly in urban areas under renovation, and since 2012, monumental graffiti is in full rebirth especially in Paris’ 13th arrondissement Through a design thought as a décor, obliterating the blandness of the walls, artists skillfully revive these soulless surfaces

programme.title: Where The Light Shines

programme.title: 聖地流動教室-以色列破謎之旅
programme.desc: 通曉中西方歷史、文學、藝術、民間傳說的學者吳宗文牧師,以及主持梁藝齡,透過鏡頭帶著電視觀眾,去到聖地各站遊歷,呈現出新舊約的《聖經》典故、歷史文獻的記載、相關的猶太傳說和傳統習俗,而更重要是從耶穌和初期信徒的記載,帶出人生的重要特質,助你成就非凡人生。

programme.title: 「創世電視福音主日」-不由你不信之從靈界迷惑到真相大白
programme.desc: 「超闊銀幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大眾化的福音主題」,加上「誠意的款待」會產生極致的「福音體驗」。奉主的名 帶著權柄與邪靈爭戰。

programme.title: 靈修早晨

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國、英國、 瑞士、澳洲、土耳其、以色列、埃及、中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。n一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天
programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面對著生命中突然而至的苦難與罪困,在天災、人禍、病困及罪咎中,有人因為痛苦不堪而選擇輕生,但亦都有人在掙扎過後,生命變得更有焦點,更清晰人生的方向。影音使團製作隊跨越中港台兩地,拍攝對象包括:台灣風災救災者、飽歷風霜的一代影星、蒙古車禍生還者、從死亡邊緣活過來的反派演員、與癌同行的歷

programme.title: 世界生命之道:鄺保亮牧師
programme.desc: 鄺保亮牧師,與父親鄺健雄牧師一同於新加坡帶領9千多人的教會,承傳父親熱心佈道的精神,繼續以激勵人心的資訊,挑戰我們成為為主擺上的門徒!

programme.title: 一生最美的祝福音樂巡迴佈道會
programme.desc: 由「愛基金」主辦、「創世電視」協辦的「一生最美的祝福音樂巡迴佈道會」,聯合不同教會的力量,加上演藝人的見證,將福音帶給香港市民。

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 郭文池牧師 - 給都市人的福音
programme.desc: 人無遠慮必有近憂,都市忙碌的生活,城市人的孤單焦慮隨處可見。究竟都市人在那裡可以找到福音?醫治心靈的良藥在那裡?

programme.title: 何偉強牧師-廿一世紀的屬靈人
programme.desc: 迷惘、沒有方向、疲乏,面對社會上的各種難題和困境,我們應該怎樣做,才能成為合符上帝心意的人? 何偉強牧師將會一連十三集,透過哥林多前書,與你講述處世之道。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室

programme.desc: 鄺保亮牧師,與父親鄺健雄牧師一同於新加坡帶領9千多人的教會,承傳父親熱心佈道的精神,繼續以激勵人心的資訊,挑戰我們成為為主擺上的門徒!

programme.title: 王一平牧師-一言道破
programme.desc: 王一平牧師全新講道系列一言道破,以精闢的教導,讓你重新認識敬拜、恩典、事奉、平安的涵意,讓聖靈重新提醒我們,怎樣做一個真基督徒。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天
programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面對著生命中突然而至的苦難與罪困,在天災、人禍、病困及罪咎中,有人因為痛苦不堪而選擇輕生,但亦都有人在掙扎過後,生命變得更有焦點,更清晰人生的方向。影音使團製作隊跨越中港台兩地,拍攝對象包括:台灣風災救災者、飽歷風霜的一代影星、蒙古車禍生還者、從死亡邊緣活過來的反派演員、與癌同行的歷

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 福氣教會講道系列
programme.desc: 如何建立健康強盛的教會? 改變社區可以轉化城市? 作為基督徒,我們又如何盡忠地完成普世宣教使命? 一個「幸福小組」,讓教會續步履行三個使命!由台灣高雄福氣教會牧者主講,從《聖經》的話語開始,一起來學習「幸福」智慧!

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 主日講壇-基督之家第五家
programme.desc: 基督之家第五家 講題:信而受洗、必然得救! 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 瘋狂歷史補習社粵
programme.desc: 王昭君天生麗質，希望成為皇帝的女人，卻被安排出嫁塞外，她分享與匈奴部落首領的婚後生活。劉邦、項羽兩股勢力對抗秦國，為何劉邦能夠獲勝？陶傑、游清源分析他的成功之道。另外，農夫給大家上一課中國人口工程。

programme.title: 瘋狂歷史補習社粵
programme.desc: 明太祖命名紫禁城的正門為「午門」，為甚麼皇帝喜歡在家門前殺人？午門除了是斬首勝地外，有否其他餘興節目？被歷史形容為奇醜無比的鍾無艷為何可獨佔大王，使其漠視美人夏迎春？陶傑、游清源話你知醜女亦有出頭天。

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 周柏豪與袁偉豪登場，Do姐份外雀躍，更稱要將農夫「炒魷魚」，換上兩位型男當助手！東京一間動漫Cafe以主角遇水即轉換性別的漫畫為主題，店內一道熊貓造型食物，淋上茶後會變成甚麼？「問題專員」凱晴在台北買來「唇膏」朱古力，「雙豪」要在真、假唇膏當中選出假貨。二人親自品嚐所選「唇膏」，可會「中伏」？韓國的泡菜種類繁多，「總角泡菜」有甚麼來頭？今集獎金再創新高，有嘉賓兌換得逾二萬元，幸運兒是……

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 張敬軒、「豹哥」單立文、「豹嫂」胡蓓蔚均熱愛音樂，三位嘉賓亮相之前，農夫竟聯想到中韓美食？旅遊資訊方面，各處鄉村各處例，搖滾手勢切勿亂做！「問題專員」胡慧冲發現泰國人會在樹幹塗上爽身粉，莫非要令樹皮變得更加幼滑？名廚余健志發揮鬼馬煮意，把常見食材變成一道「別問我是誰」，兩隊嘉賓能否猜出食材的真正身分？台中一款「心痛扭蛋」內裡只包含字條，有「搵笨」之嫌；「心動扭蛋」緊接登場，卻有女生高呼物超所值！

programme.title: 文明啟航粵英PG
programme.desc: Bettany繼續她的旅程,走訪烏茲別克、喬治亞、亞塞拜然、希臘、土耳其和保加利亞等地探索偏遠的社區,為觀眾帶來新的考古發掘以及意想不到的故事。

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 星夢頻道樂園將舉行慶典活動，可是奇蹟閃耀組、Meltic StAr、Ring Marry竟同時發生緊急狀況，無法趕上表演時間。為阻止慶典被迫中止，閃亮CHU、玫露熊與菈比莉費煞思量，就在表演時間逼近時，三人終於想到一個方法。

programme.title: 喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險2粵普
喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險2粵普
多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 大雄想要一條可在緊急時逃走的通道，多啦Ａ夢借出法寶實現他的心願，但大雄又用來惡作劇…大雄憑著多啦Ａ夢的法寶得到了想要的玩具。之後大雄到處炫耀，結果被胖虎知道了該法寶的存在…

programme.title: LET'S CAMP! 露營少女粵日
programme.desc: 鳥羽老師到達營地，三人終於有工具準備晚餐。小葵與惠那首先用番茄炮製了「不道德的番茄炒麵」，然後為了滿足小明吃薄餅的欲望，把平底鍋暫代焗爐，用現成餅底加大量番茄醬，炮製出美味薄餅。

programme.title: 嫁到這世界邊端粵
programme.desc: Laila到阿聯酋參與珠寶展，邂逅了敍利亞人Assad，就認定了他是命中註定的終身伴侶？陳貝兒到達阿聯酋首都阿布扎比，跟Laila選購黑袍，才知道當地女性穿黑袍全屬自願，遮得越多竟然是越有自信？當地女性不能隨便拍攝，攝影師即時遇到死亡恐嚇，嚇壞貝兒，背後原因是甚麼？適逢齋戒月，非教徒及遊客要遵守甚麼規矩，以示尊重？貝兒還參觀全球最貴的清真寺，與Laila暢談從放慢腳步得來的幸福。

programme.title: 飲茶粵
programme.desc: 得閒去飲茶！「飲茶文化」可追溯至香港開埠初期，茶館、茶室、茶居如何演變成茶樓、酒樓？「一盅兩件」這講法又是如何得來？戰後，主打早茶午膳的茶樓，跟專營晚飯筵席的酒家，漸漸合而為一，多層的設計更將基層市民與有錢人劃分，茶錢亦因越「高層」而遞增。節目首集還會概述茶樓員工記帳方法的進化，從「漏洞」多多的點算碟子，發展至點心卡、電腦記錄。百年茶樓的資深員工被稱呼為「茶博士」，更是致力做到「水滾茶靚」的專員？

programme.title: 飲茶粵
programme.desc: 蝦餃可謂每枱茶客必叫點心，原來這款逾百年美點由廣州艇家首創，再經酒樓改良。蝦餃要皮薄餡靚，海蝦拌入冬筍尖、肥肉做餡，講求鮮甜爽彈，以十三摺包成半月形皮才符合傳統標準！傳承舊滋味，同時尋求創新，金魚餃好精緻、花旗參湯蝦餃夠養生。凌晨三時營業的本地懷舊小店，是盈盈昔日通宵溫習後飲早茶的食堂？團隊還走訪粵、港兩地體驗飲茶賞粵曲文化。斟茶有禮儀，家英哥提到茶不能斟太滿，並帶來「叩頭」手勢源於乾隆皇的說法。

programme.title: 初入職場·中醫季粵普
programme.desc: 《初入職場·中醫季》深度聚焦中醫文化，攜手中醫專業人才及中醫助力團一起，通過"潮養生活"與"中醫歷練"，開啟一場年輕態的中醫文化科普之旅。

programme.title: Gi味俱全粵

programme.title: 魔神創造傳粵日

programme.title: Hands Up粵

programme.title: 屁屁偵探粵日

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 市民突收到信用卡交易通知，疑遭盜用信用卡網購新款智能電話，有人被刷卡近五萬。事主以日租約100元租用相機，並預繳近萬元按金，還機後卻被告知按金退還日從60工作天改為90天，及後更發現網上單據列明145天？事主質疑店方只想一拖再拖！汽車駛出停車場時疑碰到閘桿，閘燈現輕微損壞，車主被要求賠償一萬，認為不合理。歌手張與辰推行助學金計劃，資助基層學童。另送上《女神配對計劃2》花絮，以及有關米線的飲食情報。

programme.title: 中信銀行(國際)Motion$呈獻：試真D唷粵
programme.desc: 台南某旅館即使兩小時收費只約五十港元，但衛生狀況令人嘩然。坤哥進房驚見小強「迎賓」，床上更發現疑似之前住客遺留的毛髮。步近浴室，他吸一口氣已轉身想逃走！振朗首試豬油拌飯，入口瞬間雙眼發光，美儀姐亦吃得一臉滿足。光顧「走鬼」路邊爐端燒，排隊之際竟遇警方到場向店家票控！蹲在街邊品嚐完畢，美儀姐笑言可在家自煮？實測一家網傳「寫好評送甜品」的居酒屋，到底有沒有伏？振朗最終亦獲甜品招待，原因卻與網友大不同？

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：女神配對計劃2粵
programme.desc: 女神心動撳燈不設分組，求愛勇者要獲得至少三燈，或與女神心意相通，即可入圍！體操型男坦言試過一夜情，五位女神可會介意？A0自稱翻版韓星，也曾擁有AI女友，Bob啟動「外父Mode」給予考驗。彼此有共通點或可加分，海外留學、擅長下廚等特質觸動女神！某求愛男卻想藉占卜算命專長贏得青睞？男演員放膽表白，缺愛女神卻指昔日合作不太愉快？小鮮肉稱要讓女神「回春」，一秒辣㷫大家！前度震撼登場，望再續未完的故事……

programme.title: 一周星星粵
programme.desc: 對白「Vivienne有少少肚餓」於網絡流傳十幾年，Bob林盛斌和陳嘉佳(小寶)重返拍攝場地受訪。當回顧激烈擁吻戲份，小寶坦言演出前曾致電主創人王祖藍，皆因這是她的人生初吻！瓣數多的Bob被稱「金牌媒人」，卻直言沒想過開相關公司。在電商界打滾數年的小寶多少出於私心，向他提出務實建議。Bob為事業拼搏時，對家庭總有忽略，其家人拍片對他有所「投訴」？當年李思捷策劃的一場婚宴整蠱，為Bob帶來甚麼得着？

programme.title: 伯樂音樂學院20週年呈獻：J Music粵
programme.desc: 「一晚限定」，同唱片公司的谷婭溦和Irene林芊瑩共訴<一生中最愛，原來兩人是首次合唱？溦溦的<愛自己啊是想透過歌曲要大家學懂愛自己；芊瑩<如果你記得則講述從一段不被珍惜的關係中擺脫，兩首新歌被主持形容為「CP作」。入行四年的Jaime張天穎與填詞人傾談後，以一首<28:18來記錄28歲和18歲的自己並作出比較，Jaime有何反省和結論？本集亦會倒數本星期「勁歌金榜」二十位走勢。

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵
programme.desc: 張與辰帶行仔到訪一間肉餅飯專門店，品嚐超厚煎蓮藕梅香鹹魚肉餅飯，並向廚師偷師，學習炮製美味肉餅的秘訣。食評家Agnes推介一間創意料理餐廳，與施焯日細味本灣馬賽魚湯、海膽左口魚鹹魚粉煲仔飯等佳餚，充滿驚喜。美食KOL Arthur則帶何泳芍享用茶皇脆皮雞等精緻淮揚菜，並分享拍攝美食的小貼士。觀塘有餐廳推出超值下午茶優惠，包括份量十足的18元鐵板雞扒餐，更可以優惠價加配意粉及果茶，性價比極高。

programme.desc: Laila到阿聯酋參與珠寶展，邂逅了敍利亞人Assad，就認定了他是命中註定的終身伴侶？陳貝兒到達阿聯酋首都阿布扎比，跟Laila選購黑袍，才知道當地女性穿黑袍全屬自願，遮得越多竟然是越有自信？當地女性不能隨便拍攝，攝影師即時遇到死亡恐嚇，嚇壞貝兒，背後原因是甚麼？適逢齋戒月，非教徒及遊客要遵守甚麼規矩，以示尊重？貝兒還參觀全球最貴的清真寺，與Laila暢談從放慢腳步得來的幸福。

programme.title: 飲茶粵
programme.desc: 得閒去飲茶！「飲茶文化」可追溯至香港開埠初期，茶館、茶室、茶居如何演變成茶樓、酒樓？「一盅兩件」這講法又是如何得來？戰後，主打早茶午膳的茶樓，跟專營晚飯筵席的酒家，漸漸合而為一，多層的設計更將基層市民與有錢人劃分，茶錢亦因越「高層」而遞增。節目首集還會概述茶樓員工記帳方法的進化，從「漏洞」多多的點算碟子，發展至點心卡、電腦記錄。百年茶樓的資深員工被稱呼為「茶博士」，更是致力做到「水滾茶靚」的專員？

programme.title: 飲茶粵
programme.desc: 蝦餃可謂每枱茶客必叫點心，原來這款逾百年美點由廣州艇家首創，再經酒樓改良。蝦餃要皮薄餡靚，海蝦拌入冬筍尖、肥肉做餡，講求鮮甜爽彈，以十三摺包成半月形皮才符合傳統標準！傳承舊滋味，同時尋求創新，金魚餃好精緻、花旗參湯蝦餃夠養生。凌晨三時營業的本地懷舊小店，是盈盈昔日通宵溫習後飲早茶的食堂？團隊還走訪粵、港兩地體驗飲茶賞粵曲文化。斟茶有禮儀，家英哥提到茶不能斟太滿，並帶來「叩頭」手勢源於乾隆皇的說法。

programme.title: 文明啟航粵英PG

programme.desc: 朋見婷因準備會考而弄得精神緊張，特意為她購入一套增強記憶力的軟件，麗亦為婷購協助睡眠的香薰機，喜用優惠價購入大量的「補腦藥油」給婷。可是當婷使用過三人為她準備的「禮物」後，卻發現不是翻版就是貨不對辦。

programme.desc: 郭靖和黃蓉帶兵攻下撒馬爾罕城，並抓到完顏洪烈，完顏洪烈自刎前告誡郭靖，鐵木真滅了大金之後就會滅宋；郭靖在街上遇到穆念慈，把楊康已死的消息告訴她，穆念慈希望孩兒以後能堂堂正正做人，並請郭靖給孩兒起名字…

programme.desc: 「一個人的晚餐」不想吃「飯」，有用唐芹、甘筍、參峇醬炒的「參峇醬炒腸粉」、足料「法式蠔湯伴BB番薯」，以及水煮法炒出的「家肥屋潤餅」餡料，極之實用。肥媽還解答有關剩菜的問題，你可知雞蛋殼有何用處？

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 癌症患者易出現營養不良，或因生理病徵而影響食慾，也可能是聽聞傳言而過份戒口。臨床腫瘤科醫生建議患者要攝取較多蛋白質，如果遇到難以吞嚥的情況，營養奶或靜脈營養注射則是可以考慮的方向。陳松伶對獲封「兒歌天后」感恩，能與當年的小朋友共同成長亦感欣慰。今年(2026)可開個唱圓夢，她入行四十年有甚麼轉變？松松談到與年少丈夫的相處之道，認為年紀非重要，IQ才最重要？「睇餸食飯」，陳國賓示範「南瓜湯浸海鮮」。

programme.title: 懿想得到粵
programme.desc: 為了給鄭伊健一個難忘體驗，主持黎諾懿帶好友走入街市買菜，再回電視城飯堂設立秘密廚房，合力炮製「諾E海鮮麵」。曹永廉、戲劇監製羅永賢聞風而至，一嚐二人手勢，並趣談與伊健的合作往事；阿廉還笑指當年被伊健教壞，影響星途。羅冠蘭、鄭丹瑞與伊健甚有淵源，諾懿特意邀請兩位前輩到來，為伊健送上驚喜！伊健與冠蘭老師多年前因拍劇結下母子緣，這次重聚卻被「媽媽」投訴無心肝！諾懿還引領伊健重遊電視城，跟多位舊朋友聚舊。

programme.title: 天梯#15粵
programme.desc: 苗天請艷萍代他把「羊城第一莊」牌匾送給濟民，美娟欲阻新月與苗天往二牛村。鍾鑑表示要成立村務委員會，並要求新月每年資助三百元，眾人指鍾鑑搶錢。苗天與新月探望愛娣，愛娣不應門。天終於下雨，村民歡迎不已。

programme.desc: 小丸子家中雪櫃內積存了大量牛奶。為了解決此問題，小丸子向花輪同學請教如何處置剩餘的牛奶。花輪同學回答可用牛奶來烹調西式菜色及製作蛋糕等等。小丸子如實向媽媽提議，媽媽認為可行，於是開始製作奶油燉菜。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵

programme.title: 百花殺#8粵普

programme.desc: 沛堅送海琳婚紗店，藉此提升海琳身分，讓世光、莎華對她改觀。海景與文初坐三輪車兜風，不禁緬懷過去風光日子。依文、海琳與君好逛錶行遇沛祺，沛祺欲借送手錶給依文來侮辱金勝，不果。海琳父汪洋知婚紗店乃沛堅所贈，不悅。海景患上末期肺癌，自知時日無多，欲與莎嬌返家鄉上海，莎嬌以為他另有所圖，推說沒空。君好勸金勝不要流連賭場，金勝見她真關心自己，感動。眾人到海琳婚紗店拍照做宣傳，君穿起婚紗，禮信、金勝驚為天人。

programme.title: 流行都市粵

programme.title: 懿想得到粵

programme.title: 天梯#15粵

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#29粵普PG

programme.title: 懿想得到粵
programme.desc: 諾懿充當司機，踏單車帶「大細路」鄭伊健重遊電視城，並細訴拍劇百厭事。伊健拿出丫叉玩具與諾懿比拼眼力，卻反要諾懿教路？諾懿深知好兄弟愛吃牛脷酥，特意找師傅學藝，未料製作過程出現阻滯！伊健還暢談與太太的相處之道。鏡頭一轉，諾懿現身日本福岡，為薛家燕、李家鼎安排梳乎之旅。三人激玩VR恐怖遊戲，家燕姐嚇得花容失色！平戶酒店設有露天風呂，家燕姐出浴畫面震撼視覺！他們及後換上和服打卡，還可見識鼎爺的馬術功架。

programme.title: 天梯#16粵
programme.desc: 麗荷表示父親要家明事業有成才讓她下嫁。愛娣懷了身孕，鄭嬌無奈把懷胎的事告知愛娣，翌晨愛娣藉口請鄭嬌替她買糖蓮子送藥，鄭嬌歸來時卻發覺愛娣不知所蹤。鄭嬌找至懸崖邊發現愛娣的手帕，立即跳下海中。

programme.title: Hands Up粵

programme.desc: 文謙等人經常主動為希靈效勞，代她處理各種事務。希靈慶幸遇上一班好同事，同時卻覺得自己缺乏存在價值。另一方面，曾背叛萬里的前秘書Ada如今成為冠一的得力助手，她能力出眾，令希靈相形見拙。Ada發現希靈犯錯後出言揶揄，更揭露眾人為她效勞的真相。希靈打算辭職，楊帆得悉後極力挽留，並主動協助她改善工作表現……其後，希靈就某個項目提出創新構思，獲萬里讚賞。萬里更表示有意重用她，背後原來另有盤算……

programme.title: 死有對証#7粵PG
programme.desc: 林琛前往案發現場調查時遇交通意外，命芷昕處理暴龍的初步驗屍工作，淑嫻為此案擔心不已。高俊暫被列為嫌疑人，需放假接受調查。林琛將暴龍的解剖工作也交給芷昕負責，高俊為打探案件發展，請芷昕吃飯，但芷昕緊守操守，沒透露半句細節，高俊着急。柏宇拍攝了暴龍橫死的畫面，不斷大造文章針對高俊，佩嘉不齒柏宇所作所為。文琪陪同芷昕回案發現場調查，芷昕有新思緒……芷昕與佩嘉到暴龍的酒吧，要尋找關鍵證物……

programme.title: 百花殺#9粵普PG
programme.desc: 汐和遭放暗箭，終發現是青姝所為，但汐和放她一命。皇上即將賜婚，但汐和仍表明對華雍並無男女之情。汐和遭埋伏，她單憑香氣便認出此事與雁回有關；華雍因而擔心汐和終會識破自己一直隱藏的一面，繼而毒症發作昏倒。

programme.title: 藍朋友‧旅朋友 廣西篇粵
programme.desc: 南寧有三街兩巷，明清時期已是最旺的商埠核心，集結地道美食、歷史建築。祖藍帶兆麟往吃炒生料，酸酸辣辣夠過癮。然後再到戲劇主題博物館，跟老師學習當地邕劇，兆麟竟將偶像劇元素融入演出？來賓的金秀縣是國家的瑤都，兩人換上民族服，接受瑤民的歡迎儀式，並一嚐廣西非遺油茶。祖藍還為兆麟安排相親，能徒手爬樓、有力打糍粑，就是吸引點，而原來瑤族盛行女娶男嫁？祖藍做證婚人見證着兆麟「出嫁」，還召喚族內鄉親共享長桌宴！

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
澳娛綜合呈獻：十月初五的月光#7粵
programme.desc: 莎嬌與美鳳看眾人婚紗照，覺禮信與君好合襯。君好生日將至，不害臊向眾人索取禮物。禮信與金勝不知不覺間同時愛上君好。文初雖知自己對咖哩粉敏感，仍為君好學煮咖哩蟹。冰心知展輝購名貴生日禮物給君好，決心部署逐步接收展輝的生意。禮信見文初緊張銀雞感好奇，文初說出自己身世及如何使用銀雞表達意思。文初、禮信及金勝分別為君好預備生日蛋糕，君好向著三個蛋糕許願。禮信因公事要先回港，把握機會用文初的銀雞向君好示愛。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 「香港搖滾教父」夏韶聲除了音樂事業外，更跨界投入漫畫創作，甚至為自家漫畫打造主題曲，他會到臨分享箇中創作點滴。夏爺亦是愛家好男人，談到和子女、孫兒的相處，臉上總是洋溢着幸福笑容。「跟大廚去搵食」，這次李偉強師傅帶大王、菲比品嚐正宗川滋味。師傅推介「川味蒜心豆干炒臘腸」、「霸王滋味雞」、「京燒脆皮羊肉」等菜式，可吃出川菜的「麻、辣、燙」三大經典風味。「睇餸食飯」，三姐示範「炸冬瓜燜鹹香豬筒骨」。

programme.title: 懿想得到粵
programme.desc: 諾懿充當司機，踏單車帶「大細路」鄭伊健重遊電視城，並細訴拍劇百厭事。伊健拿出丫叉玩具與諾懿比拼眼力，卻反要諾懿教路？諾懿深知好兄弟愛吃牛脷酥，特意找師傅學藝，未料製作過程出現阻滯！伊健還暢談與太太的相處之道。鏡頭一轉，諾懿現身日本福岡，為薛家燕、李家鼎安排梳乎之旅。三人激玩VR恐怖遊戲，家燕姐嚇得花容失色！平戶酒店設有露天風呂，家燕姐出浴畫面震撼視覺！他們及後換上和服打卡，還可見識鼎爺的馬術功架。

programme.title: 天梯#16粵
programme.desc: 麗荷表示父親要家明事業有成才讓她下嫁。愛娣懷了身孕，鄭嬌無奈把懷胎的事告知愛娣，翌晨愛娣藉口請鄭嬌替她買糖蓮子送藥，鄭嬌歸來時卻發覺愛娣不知所蹤。鄭嬌找至懸崖邊發現愛娣的手帕，立即跳下海中。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#185粵
programme.desc: 朋到根家為眾人準備聖誕禮物時，令根羨慕高家的聖誕氣氛。朋偶然偷聽到，家人對他每年所準備的「節目」有所不滿，令朋自覺只是眾人在勉強配合自己，令他頓感心灰意冷。朋竟在聖誕前夕，訛稱有約而取消了所有活動。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#30粵普PG
programme.desc: 受困於心魔，郭靖欲輕生，幸獲一燈大師點化，同時裘千仞亦皈依佛門。蒙古軍營內黃蓉重遇郭靖，誓言生死相隨，此時歐陽鋒因練武而變得瘋癲。成吉思汗病重撤軍，襄陽倖免於難。華山論劍之約到來，黃蓉攜郭靖去看熱鬧…

programme.title: 美女廚房粵
programme.desc: 嘉賓評判農夫、洪永城隔着廚房門，欣賞三位美女煮食時的「手勢」，競猜廚房主人。三女分別被標籤為「90後」、「宅男女神」及「舞林高手」，各有招數搶分，有人煮出冥鏹的味道，有人施展令蝦滲入雞味的魔法，亦有人憑實力取得多個滿分！她們還用澳洲雪蟹來煮男朋友餐，間接透露了兩位圈內男士的口味取向。主持及嘉賓評分時心大心細，連給予同情分的理由都各自精采！今集大熱於試食前竟重提主持張振朗分手一事，會否因此被扣分？

programme.title: CI ALK 國際直球對決(重)
CI ALK 國際直球對決(重)

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜為奪下豪門不擇手段！】人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象。出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友。當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨、正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始。

programme.title: 殘酷的實習生
programme.desc: 【羅美蘭化身高年級實習生道盡女性職場家庭壓力】曾叱吒職場的女強人高海羅，在為家庭中斷事業七年後，決心重返職場、找回自我價，從主管跌回實習生，她不僅要面對年齡與職場現實的殘酷挑戰，更得直面昔日競爭對手、如今成為上司的崔智媛。在一項充滿道德兩難的任務中，海羅被迫於同為母親的立場與職涯機會之間掙扎。劇情深刻刻畫中年女性在家庭、工作與自我之間的拉扯與重生，以真實而細膩的情感，引發無數職場女性共鳴。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: 小小動物歷險記

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 【話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！】最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人。為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中。

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜為奪下豪門不擇手段！】人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象。出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友。當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨、正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始。

programme.title: 殘酷的實習生(完)
programme.desc: 【羅美蘭化身高年級實習生道盡女性職場家庭壓力】曾叱吒職場的女強人高海羅，在為家庭中斷事業七年後，決心重返職場、找回自我價，從主管跌回實習生，她不僅要面對年齡與職場現實的殘酷挑戰，更得直面昔日競爭對手、如今成為上司的崔智媛。在一項充滿道德兩難的任務中，海羅被迫於同為母親的立場與職涯機會之間掙扎。劇情深刻刻畫中年女性在家庭、工作與自我之間的拉扯與重生，以真實而細膩的情感，引發無數職場女性共鳴。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 當你沉睡時

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: Ollie! The Boy Who Became What He Ate
programme.desc: Ollie is a 6-year-old with a massive imagination, often lost in his own world - flipping, sliding, climbing and rocket-blasting through the house, practicing at being the master of all things. But even masters need to stop and refuel. When meals or snack time interrupt Ollie’s play, he finds himself confronted with the real challenge of childhood; trying new food. To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

programme.desc: Gods Gang

programme.desc: God's Gang embarks on an underwater mission to rescue blue whales, only to encounter an alien ambush. The team faces unexpected challenges while trying to infiltrate a clandestine blue whale party. Suspense builds as they attempt a daring rescue operation.

programme.desc: Oh no, there's a traffic jam, and Lilly's stuck on the level crossing! Troy has the perfect plan to help.

programme.desc: Troy helps Tyler and Jerry race by bringing in a third contender. Now let's see who wins the race!

programme.desc: Troy spots a fire in Car City and wastes no time getting Frank to the building to put the fire out!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Gary the Garbage Truck cleans Car City
programme.desc: There's trash all over Car City! Troy selects the perfect truck to take care of it: Gary the Garbage Truck!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Charlie the Crane clear the bridge
programme.desc: Some trees fell and are blocking the bridge! Troy selects the perfect truck to clear it: Charlie the Crane!

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is a curious little robot who loves making friends, discovering new things, and having fun with music, magic, animals, and more. Every day is a new adventure for Rookie—whether he’s chasing a bouncing ball, exploring the stars, or learning how something works. He’s always ready to laugh, try again when things get tricky, and share big smiles with the friends he meets along the way. With Rookie, even the smallest moments become exciting discoveries!

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - Sabotaje
programme.desc: Chip es un niño de 9 años que prefiere jugar con sus compañeros antes de las clases de física y química con su maestra Susan. Un día, durante una visita escolar al Instituto de Alta Energía, un científico loco, el Dr. No, está realizando un experimento con una lente capaz de convertir materia en antimateria, lo que provoca un accidente y un rayo incontrolado que lanza a Chip y al científico a la dimensión del micromundo. Chip se da cuenta de que el accidente lo ha enviado a un lugar desconocido y no sabe cómo regresar. Unos átomos de hierro, mercurio e hidrógeno, representados como Fer, Merc e Hidro, lo guiarán para ayudarlo a encontrar el camino de vuelta. Al mismo tiempo, el Dr. No descubre que, debido al accidente, ha logrado crear antimateria, y el poder que esto le otorga lo prepara para convertirse en el amo del mundo.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La corriente electrica
programme.desc: Fer, Merc e Hidro llevan a Chip a la Ciudad Atómica, donde hay noticias de otro humano, el Dr. No, que ha llegado al micromundo. Chip piensa que tal vez el Dr. No podría ayudarlo a regresar a su dimensión, y va a verlo para devolverle la lente que el científico perdió durante el viaje al micromundo. Pero el Dr. No está construyendo la Torre Negra, una poderosa máquina que lo ayudará a esclavizar a todos los átomos del micromundo. Ahora tiene muchos trabajando bajo sus órdenes, y los lanza contra Chip y sus amigos para convertirlos en prisioneros y arrebatarles la lente. Al escapar, Chip cae en una corriente eléctrica que lo transporta muy lejos.

programme.desc: There's a blackout in Car City! Troy selects the most ingenious truck to reconnect the cables: Chuck the Cherry Picker!

programme.desc: A lost container sends Troy into investigation mode. Who and where did it come from? He's very helpful and can transform!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - The Babies' trip to the Moon
programme.desc: The Babies are fascinated by the moon! Troy selects the most cosmic truck to help them get there: Rocky the Rocket!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - El castillo de Robins
programme.desc: Como la lente no se puede recuperar, el Dr. No quiere fabricar otra, pero necesita petirrojos para ello. Así que ataca Rubidia, una región repleta de piedras preciosas. Pero Oxin, el rey de Rubidia, lo toma prisionero y lo encierra en el castillo donde también está Chip, ya que Oxin los obliga a trabajar como esclavos en sus minas. El Dr. No intenta convencer a Chip de que le devuelva la lente, pero Chip se niega. Más tarde, ambos logran escapar del castillo y el Dr. No persigue a Chip con su nave. Pero el chico atrapa al científico y también ayuda a liberar a los esclavos de Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La trampa de la armonica
programme.desc: Chip y sus amigos crean una zona con formaciones que se asemejan a instrumentos musicales y armonizan sus sonidos. De repente, quedan atrapados en un rectángulo de cristales de cuarzo que vibran al formar una trampa sónica. Un átomo músico, que los ha capturado, busca miembros para formar una orquesta. Los antimateriales están cerca y Chip le pide al músico que prepare la trampa para retenerlos y escapar. El músico acepta y los antimateriales se convierten en prisioneros, obligándolos a escuchar el terrible sonido de sus composiciones.

programme.title: The Beautiful Spark
programme.desc: After losing his job in a scandal, Michelin-starred chef Philippe gets a second chance at La Belle Étincelle - a unique restaurant run by Virginie, and staffed by her autistic son Noé alongside other young people with disabilities.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Calcutta
programme.desc: Having just lost her daughter and disillusioned with her marriage, Ela decides to start an independent life of her own. Unable to secure a housing loan, she uses her boss, the owner of a ponzi scheme, to get what she wants.

programme.title: Brother's Keeper
programme.desc: Yusuf’s best friend, Memo falls gravely ill. Isolated in their boarding school located in the snowy mountains, tensions run high as Yusuf’s calls for help for Memo becomes increasingly difficult in the face of an authoritarian and bureaucratic system.

programme.title: Being Mortal
programme.desc: Xia Tian relocates to her hometown to care for her dad, who suffered from Alzheimer for over a decade. She thought it would help her parents. However, as the disease worsens, she has to face the pressure of life. And the only thing she can do is to wait.

programme.title: Running To The Sky
programme.desc: Twelve-year-old Jekshen is an exceptional runner living in a beautiful mountain village in Kyrgyzstan. Struggling to live with his divorced alcoholic father, Jeksen sees an upcoming big race as an opportunity to change his life for the better.

programme.desc: Rob Rinder and Monica Galetti work 3,000m above sea level at Gangtey Lodge, Bhutan, in a remote region that only obtained electricity 11 years ago. This luxury hotel has oxygen cans on hand, and the chef prepares meals to help guests adjust to the altitude. During their stay, Monica learns the area's pastime of archery and how locals make butter and cheese for the hotel's kitchen, while Rob masters a song in Bhutanese. They also pay a visit to the neighbouring Buddhist monastery.

There is also a combination that will trick and tantalise viewers' taste buds - carrot cake pakoras with a mouthwatering cream cheese dip.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Australia S01 - EP6
programme.desc: Rick Stein's journey around New South Wales takes him from the country's interior back to the NSW South Coast. He's passionate about its future, and especially the sustainability of its exquisite seafood.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Sponge
programme.desc: Bella and Lift have fun playing with sponges, and so does Tincy the Spider in the Sing Song Forest - just watch out for those soapy bubbles!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Choir Badge
programme.desc: After overhearing Duggee listening to a beautiful track by the Squirrel Valley Voices Choir, the Squirrels seek to learn more about the roles that make up a choir - basses, sopranos, altos and tenors. A distressed Eugene then alerts them that half of the choir have been taken sick and can't perform that day. The Squirrels step up to take their place. Initially, when the newly arranged choir sing, the voices aren't gelling together. Duggee teaches them the principles they must get right first, fo

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Feelings Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels notice that Happy looks and seems different - he is frowning, his smile is upside down, and he's wearing new trainers! When they check in on him, Happy is frustrated, but he can't seem to identify where his frustration is coming from. They turn to Duggee for help, who uses his feeling cards to explain an array of feelings to Happy. All the Squirrels help by relaying their past experiences and the feelings that they evoked.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Days of the Week Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are excited to learn that Mr Wobbly, the jelly juggler, is coming to town, and they can't wait to see him. But they become impatient, so Duggee makes sure to explain to them that the week will fly by and there's a lot to be done in that time. Duggee explains that a week is made up of seven days and what activities he does each day to stay busy. Each squirrel excitedly shares their usual plans between Monday and Friday so that they have something to look forward to while they wait f

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - The Parthenon, Greece
programme.desc: Inspired by his favourite action film, Grand Master Glitch plans to make a blockbuster of his own, but first he needs to find the right setting for an action adventure.

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - Easter Island, Chile
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch is on holiday to the remote Easter Island to avoid crowds, but when he arrives he finds droves of tourists everywhere!

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S24 - Emily to the Rescue
programme.desc: When a Pretend Emergency turns into a Real Emergency, there's only one engine who can save the day.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S03 - Dewy Morning
programme.desc: Sarah and Duck are so keen to visit the art shop, they get there too early and have to find things to keep themselves entertained.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S03 - Sticker Swap
programme.desc: Sarah is keen to complete her sticker album, so sets off to see if her friends can help with her collection.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Library Book
programme.desc: Stanley must track down the missing library book, 'The Little Book of New Things to Do'. He visits various townsfolk who have leant the book to each other.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Treasure
programme.desc: Morris and Pearl have lost one of their medals in the canal. Stanley fishes it out only have the complete collection dropped in. Stanley dons a diver's suit and goes after them.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - I'm Not Even Scared of Nothing
programme.desc: Werewolves, cobras, alligators, and commando dragons! The animals chat about all the things which absolutely do not make them scared.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S03 - It's Time for a Roller Disco
programme.desc: JoJo is learning to roller skate in the garden with Gran Gran, but there's not enough room to try all the moves. It's time for a Gran Gran plan - they head off to the roller disco!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Promises
programme.desc: Bluey keeps breaking her promises! But after seeing how much Bingo trusts Mum's word, Bluey learns the power of promises and why it's important not to break them.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Omelette
programme.desc: Bingo is helping Mum make an omelette for Dad's birthday breakfast, but cracking eggs is harder than it looks, and Dad is getting hungrier by the minute.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Born Yesterday
programme.desc: Dad pretends he was born yesterday. Bluey and Bingo have to guide him through his second day on Earth, especially when he discovers food is delicious and steals Lucky's Dad's pie.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Metal Detector Badge
programme.desc: It's a lovely day, so everyone is playing outside. Things take a turn when Roly needs a wee, because the door is locked and Duggee has mislaid the key. The Squirrels start looking around for it, but they have no luck. Not to worry, Duggee has his metal detector, Helen. After demonstrating it to the Squirrels, they are very keen to give it a go.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Diary Badge
programme.desc: The day starts when Duggee moves a cupboard, and the Squirrels find a dusty, old book behind it. It's Duggee's diary from when he was a teenager! The Squirrels aren't sure what a diary is, so Duggee explains by reading some extracts. The Squirrels are keen to write diaries of their own.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - El Gran Final
programme.desc: Join the chickens in space for the big finale of Agony and Eggstacy! Mucho Suspense!

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Go Jet Academy: Wind Power
programme.desc: It's a very windy day at the Go Jet Academy as Jetpad comes in to land, zooming past the academy's windfarm turbines. Meanwhile, in a field nearby, Grandmaster Glitch is teaching his grimbots a lesson all about wind power by trying to fly a giant kite. But as the kite is launched, the strong wind catches it and pulls Glitch up, up and away - and straight towards a huge spinning turbine!

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Kiwi
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Kiwi performing Do the Kiwi Dance - if he manages to find someone to interview him first.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Coconut
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Coconut getting his moment in the limelight with his sea shanty Oh, the Big Waves - if he manages to overcome a little stage fright.

programme.title: Supertato S02 - The Amazing Jalapeno
programme.desc: Chilli can't wait to see his hero Jalapeno attempt a treacle-tart jumping record. But Evil Pea adds an extra tart at the end of the jump, and Jalapeno gets stuck. As Supertato tries to rescue him, Evil Pea claims that she will break the record - by cheating. But just as Evil Pea starts her jump, Supertato pulls Jalapeno free with his plunger, and they all get tangled midair. programme.desc: The Tubby Car takes the Teletubbies to the Hidey Hup where they discover the Tubby Slidey. Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-­Laa and Po have great fun sliding down again and again.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Who Duggit?

But just as Evil Pea starts her jump, Supertato pulls Jalapeno free with his plunger, and they all get tangled midair. Chilli transforms into Captain Chilli and does the jump himself, saving Supertato and Jalapeno as Evil Pea drops into the

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Robotato Returns
programme.desc: Carrot is excited to show the Tato Team her new inventions, including an improved Robotato, who will help them protect the supermarket from Evil Pea. Unfortunately, Robotato still has a few glitches, so the veggies decide to test Carrot's new jetpacks instead, but Evil Pea sneaks in and commands Robotato to protect her. When Robotato continues to glitch, he becomes overly protective of Evil Pea and takes her to the top of Tato Tower to keep her safe. The Tato Team, led by the real Supertato, mus

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Sliding Down
programme.desc: The Tubby Car takes the Teletubbies to the Hidey Hup where they discover the Tubby Slidey. Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-­Laa and Po have great fun sliding down again and again.

programme.title: Love With The Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: After breaking up with his girlfriend, salesman Bao meets a rich girl, Jin Jin, who just broke up with her boyfriend. Two equally heartbroken strangers fall in love instantly and get married on impulse. The couple lives happily together until Jin Jin finds herself pregnant with her ex-boyfriend's baby...

programme.title: The Treasure Hunters
programme.desc: An elite fortune hunter and a reckless young heir team up to search for a legendary pirate treasure. Their quest leads them to a remote monastery, where they must outwit a formidable Shaolin monk. However, when ruthless bandits close in, the unlikely allies must put aside their differences and fight side by side to survive.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular "Venom" Lo Meng.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as "City Lights", is the directorwriter's warm-hearted memoir of street life back in the early 1980s, featuring an eclectic cast of pop music and kung fu stars who shine in their poignant roles.

programme.title: The Twin Swords
programme.desc: Gui Wu and his wife Gan Lian Zhu are the famous “Twin Swords” in the martial arts world. One day, they stumble upon a kidnapping plot at the Red Lotus Temple and Lian Zhu is held captive. Wu successfully escapes to find the Gan family for help, not knowing that he is sending them into an ambush by the kidnappers. Can he finally save Lian Zhu?

programme.title: A Deadly Secret
programme.desc: A corrupt magistrate, obsessed with finding a hidden treasure, jails and tortures his daughter's lover and buries his daughter alive! Ironically, it is in her coffin that the secret to the hidden treasure is found, setting off a frenzy of destruction.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: Perils Of The Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Chu Liuxiang and the Eighth Prince stage a fake assassination attempt, allowing Chu to infiltrate Ghostly Manor as an undercover agent and eradicate this den of evil. The manor harbours notorious martial arts criminals and is rumoured to be haunted. Soon, during his investigation, Chu becomes entangled in a series of mysterious and eerie events.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: Ambitious Kung Fu Girl
programme.desc: Si Si, a spoiled and naive rich girl with only basic kung fu training, becomes enchanted by the legends of the fearless hero Qin Ge. Determined to escape her father's arranged marriage, she disguises herself as a man and sets out to find him, hoping to challenge Qin Ge-only to be drawn into a deadly plot within the criminal underworld.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers' gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as "a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders", it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: Return of the One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: One-armed Swordsman Fang Kang wants to lead a quiet life with his wife, but when she is abducted by the Eight Demon Swordsmen clan, he is forced to take them on in order to save her.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang who must also prove his own legitimacy. The plot thickens with murder, sibling rivalry and shocking discoveries that could change the course of history.

programme.title: The Flag of Iron
programme.desc: When super director Chang Cheh found new talent and blood with "The Five Venoms" actors, most of which were trained in the highly acrobatic Chinese opera and well versed with exotic martial arts weapons, this created a new spark for his use of bizarre weapons in his films. The Flag Of Iron is one of 20 movies that he directed featuring the utterly flabbergasting and physically exhausting action bits created by these five dudes. You have the good guys from the righteous clan versus the bad guys f

programme.title: The Flag of Iron
programme.desc: When super director Chang Cheh found new talent and blood with "The Five Venoms" actors, most of which were trained in the highly acrobatic Chinese opera and well versed with exotic martial arts weapons, this created a new spark for his use of bizarre weapons in his films. The Flag Of Iron is one of 20 movies that he directed featuring the utterly flabbergasting and physically exhausting action bits created by these five dudes. You have the good guys from the righteous clan versus the bad guys f

programme.title: Operation Lipstick
programme.desc: A professor's assistant stole a micro-film storing the secret of a newly invented nuclear reactor and sells it to a crime syndicate. However, the micro-film accidentally falls into the hands of a nightclub dancer and a thief in the process, leading to them being relentlessly pursued by the crime syndicate to retrieve the micro-film.

programme.title: Legendary Weapons of China
programme.desc: Lei Kung, the leader of the Boxer Clan in Yunnan, dissolves the clan to save his disciples before going into self-exile. The Clan sends various assassins to kill him but failed. They then assigned Kung's brother Yong to find and kill Kung, leading to a battle between the two brothers.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back...

programme.title: Five Superfighters
programme.desc: A kung fu master and his three students lost everything after they are floored by a bully. To take revenge, the students find ways to learn from other kung fu masters and come back six months later to have a rematch with the bully on their master's birthday.

programme.title: Song Of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Dr. He moves to the remote Lanyu island off the coast of Taiwan to look for his long lost father, and starts to run a clinic curing islanders who are bitten by the fatal red worms there. He meets Ya Lan who works as a nurse in his clinic and falls in love with him. Things get vicious for Dr. He as a jealous islander plots to get rid of him...

programme.title: Shaolin Mantis
programme.desc: The Emperor orders Feng to find proofs of Master Tian's rebellion in his house. Feng falls in love with Tian's granddaughter and marries her. When he finds the proofs and tries to leave with her, his wife is killed in the fight against Tian. Feng creates the mantis-style martial arts and vows to avenge her death.

programme.title: River of Tears
programme.desc: Retired singer Fang lives happily with her husband and son. Tragedy happens when a man from her past returns to haunt her. In an ensuing struggle to free her from his clutches, her husband dies in a car accident. Blamed by her father-in-law for her husband's death, Fang gets chased out of the house and goes back to singing to make a living...

programme.title: Heroes of the East
programme.desc: A Chinese man marries a Japanese woman through an arranged marriage and manages to insult all of her Japanese martial arts family by issuing a challenge to her that is misinterpreted by the others. He must then prove how good Chinese Kung Fu really is through a series of duels with the seven Japanese martial artists who come to meet the challenge!

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: The Magnificent Trio
programme.desc: A group of farmers who are being oppressed by the local magistrates kidnap one of the magistrate's daughter in the hope of being heard by the authorities. A wandering swordsman offers his help and aiding him are two fighters who have both switched sides from being the oppressors to the oppressed. The trio fight back against the magistrates!

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an unlikely romance begins.

programme.title: Raw Courage
programme.desc: After the Ming Emperor is overthrown and his infant son was put in the care of the Black Dragon Society, a traitorous martial arts clan attacks the society, forcing an inexperienced pair of swordsman and swordswoman to flee with the infant. Their journey to deliver the infant to safety is filled with dangers that would require help from other allies...

programme.title: Asia-pol
programme.desc: Asiapol agent Yang Ming Xuan trails a shipment of contraband gold being delivered to gang leader, George Eaton. He enlists the help of a Chinese woman who is trying to avenge her sister and narrowly escapes several deadly traps as he closes in on Eaton's location. This spy film is loosely inspired by the James Bond movies.

programme.title: Asia-pol
programme.desc: Asiapol agent Yang Ming Xuan trails a shipment of contraband gold being delivered to gang leader, George Eaton. He enlists the help of a Chinese woman who is trying to avenge her sister and narrowly escapes several deadly traps as he closes in on Eaton's location. This spy film is loosely inspired by the James Bond movies.

programme.title: Pursuit
programme.desc: This movie tells the tale of Lin Chong, the Sung Dynasty's Chief Army Instructor who is framed by a corrupt official and has to embark on an exile fraught with danger. Helped by a monk, Lin Chong is finally able to take revenge.

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: Continuing the success of the classic comedy “House of 72 tenants”, this sequel tells the stories of tenants living in an old building in Hong Kong who are forced to evict by the developers. Some tenants prefer to take the compensation while some resist the move. Will the acquisitions plan destroy the harmony of the neighborhood?

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: The Lark
programme.desc: Sixties pop star Carrie Ku plays the "Little Lark" in this romantic-drama of mistaken identity that is a treasure trove of some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time.

programme.title: The Hidden Power Of Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: Defeated villain Sung Ching Shu returns and starts a reign of terror, trapping a beautiful Mongolian Princess and mastering the "yin and yang combination" to become almost invincible. Only two swords held by two great swordsmen can stand in his way!

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: Return to the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: The second film of the trilogy, Gordon Liu plays Zhou Ren Jie, a man who impersonates a monk in order to learn kung fu in Shaolin, and eventually creates his own Shaolin style of ‘scaffolding kung fu”.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: The Lady is the Boss
programme.desc: Mei, a young overseas Chinese woman, returns to Hong Kong to take over a traditional martial arts school. Her modern management style clashes with her conservative senior disciple, sparking disputes and attracting local gangsters. Forced to put aside their differences, they join forces to fight back and defend the school's honour.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang's popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre 2
programme.desc: Only by bringing together the powerful Heaven Sword and the mighty Dragon Sabre can six martial arts sects struggling for supremacy be saved in this thrilling sequel to Chu Yuan's original hit.

programme.title: The Deadly Duo
programme.desc: The prince of the Sung Dynasty is captured by the Chin invaders and guarded by top martial arts masters. Two powerful patriots need to fight the overwhelming odds and pull off the impossible: to rescue the royal Prince and get out of the Chin stronghold alive.

programme.title: The Weird Man
programme.desc: During the Three Kingdoms period, a Taoist priest Yu Ji cures many patients with his supernatural powers and is loved by the people. However, the arrogant general Sun Che thinks that Yu Ji bewitches people and orders for him to be beheaded. Subsequently, the spirit of the Yu Ji rises from his dead body and takes revenge on Sun Che.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take back what is rightfully theirs. These kids grow up to exact a vengeance that turns out to be more hilarious than horrific in this comedy.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school’s stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm’s VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Hong Kong detective Eddie dies while rescuing a mystical child during an international search for a human trafficking syndicate. Revived by the sacred Medallion, he gains extraordinary healing powers. However, when his ruthless nemesis also seizes its power, Eddie must storm a sinister castle and fight in a brutal battle for survival.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar’s gang when he saves the gang’s elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian and seek evidence against his gang. After their release, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, as Shan cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its “Cop Shop Babes” as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat – can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then…

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair…

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau’s Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city’s casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A reactivated backup Chinese agent, posing as a butcher, is unexpectedly assigned to recover a stolen dinosaur skull. Sent to Hong Kong, he is aided by a female agent who is secretly working for the villains. Together, they navigate betrayals and confront the mastermind, ultimately recovering the national treasure and exposing the conspiracy.

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch—but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The legendary Stone Monkey gives hope to a desperate girl by promising to change her fate. Years later, after a fierce battle against the powerful three-eyed God of War, he is defeated and cast into the mortal world. Stripped of his former glory, Stone Monkey must rise again, confront powerful enemies, and fulfil the promise he once made.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. Soon after, her photographer receives eerie phone calls, a writer suffers a bizarre car accident, and Min’s friend suddenly vanishes. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Min’s death.

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter’s company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a “super pill” invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B’s superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father’s land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: The Great Magician
programme.desc: Warlord Lui Dai Ngau commands a powerful army but fails to win the heart of Lau Yiu, whom he keeps in his mansion against her will. Meanwhile, renowned magician Cheung Yin arrives to perform for Lui, while secretly plotting to rescue Lau Yiu and avenge the tragedy that destroyed his family years ago.

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua’s hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong’s biggest stars

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister’s daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man…

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister’s daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man…

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter —the sole witness— mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Martial arts master Liang Kun withdraws from the jianghu to protect the woman he loves, but his absence leads to her tragic death. Realising he can no longer escape his fate, he returns to the martial world. With the help of beggar clan leader Su Can, Liang Kun fights his way through ruthless enemies to avenge her.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao’s enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei’s concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Look for a Star
programme.desc: Sam is a charismatic tycoon who has been divorced three times. When he meets Milan, a cabaret dancer and croupier, they immediately fall in love. However, their romance faces challenges when he proposes a prenuptial agreement, putting their budding relationship at risk.

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian arms dealer to locate and destroy a cache of munitions. However, when he finally finds them, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and must team up with his partner to recover the weapons and prevent a disaster.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveller
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee (aka. Li Hsiu-hsien) as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tai's father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai…

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Gorgeous
programme.desc: A romantic message in a bottle sends Taiwanese girl Ah Bu on a quest to Hong Kong to find its author, Albert. Disheartened when he turns out to be nothing like she imagined, she prepares to return home. However, her plans take an unexpected turn when she encounters Chan, a wealthy tycoon, and an unlikely romance begins to bloom.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: The World Today
programme.desc: The core rolling news service of CGTN, with regular updates from Beijing, Washington, Nairobi and London, keep viewers up-to-date with all the world’s top stories as they happen. The World Today delivers breaking news, live events, in-depth reporting, expert analysis and sustained coverage.

programme.title: Razor
programme.desc: CGTN's brand new science and technology show, covering cutting edge developments from all over the world. RAZOR will show you the world's most powerful laser and the world's smallest anti-cancer treatment. It will take you from the weird world of quantum computing to the boundaries of the cosmos. An international team of reporters will follow the guidance of Occam's Razor - the principle that the simplest explanation is the best one. RAZOR will show that we are already ""living in the future"!

programme.title: Africa Live

Local correspondents and local production teams provide authoritative and in-depth stories from across the region. Africa Live is an objective and comprehensive look at every facet of African life.
